So, I've had the cart a couple of weeks. It's really a great little investment for my space. I live deep in the woods and the wagon deloes extremely well over uneven and stick laden pathways It's sturdy. I use it to haul green garbage to the precapice, collect sticks for kindling. Hauling my gardening tools and et al to wherever I'll be working. Be it the crazy yard or the veggie garden or in the woods to gather mushrooms, berries and kindling. I put down one side and pad the bottom with cardboard to use it as a seat to work on the ground, esp in the garden. My only complaint is the wheels are super squeaky and I wish there was some sort of cushion around the axle to hush the noise (it gets the neighbor dogs barking). Also I love big sturdy box it came in makes for a cover to park it under. I love my wagon. Going to teach my dog to pull it
